subject: Re: Kickoff: Differentiable Data Selection for vision training
body:
Status, a bit late for the April 24 milestone but with a clean result.

Reproduction: done. Baseline WRN-28-10 on CIFAR-10 matches the reference setup (cosine decay, EMA 0.9999, 100k steps, bfloat16 on Cirrus), and the DDS run on top shows +0.6 accuracy over the baseline, consistent with the paper's reported effect size.

The fiddly part was scorer stability: with the documented scorer_lr=1e-06 the scorer barely moves early on, but raising it 10x made example weights oscillate and hurt final accuracy. We landed back on 1e-06 with scorer_clip=0.5 doing the real stabilization work. Writing this up so the pilot doesn't rediscover it.

Risk for the pilot: our internal corpus has label noise CIFAR does not, and DDS's value should be larger there -- but the scorer checkpoint quality becomes critical. Bilal's pipeline is ready.

Quentin
